name: al-corporate-tax
description: Albanian corporate income tax (tatimi mbi të ardhurat e korporatave, often called tatimi mbi fitimin) for tax year 2026 under Law No. 29/2023 'Për tatimin mbi të ardhurat' as amended to Law No. 81/2025. Covers resident companies and permanent establishments of foreign companies: the 15% rate, the 8% dividend rate, the 0% rate for entities with gross income up to ALL 14 million until 2029, the 5% sector rates, the taxable base, 30% EBITDA interest limit, depreciation rates, participation exemption, five-year loss carry-forward, quarterly advance payments, the 31 March annual return, penalties under the tax procedures law, withholding at 8% and 15%, and exit tax. Trigger on 'Albania corporate tax', 'tatimi mbi fitimin', 'Albanian profit tax', 'SHPK tax Albania', '15% Albania', 'parapagime', 'withholding tax Albania dividends'. Out of scope: individuals and sole traders (albania-income-tax), VAT (albania-vat), payroll (albania-payroll), social contributions (albania-social-contributions),
